P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder figure appears anywhere on the page; the only image is an abstract geometric/architectural photo.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections with client portraits; the page contains only numbered problem descriptions with no imagery of people.

P07.rationale: No social-proof apparatus is present — no logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonials appear on this page.

P10.rationale: The numbered list uses small colored numerals for structure, but there are no oversized decorative ghost numerals or large quote glyphs used as typographic decoration.

P11.rationale: No data visualisations, charts, before/after comparisons, or cost-math graphics are present; statistics are cited only as inline text.

P12.rationale: The layout has a clear structure with a headline, body text, image, and a numbered grid, but the overall density is moderate with noticeable open areas, falling short of magazine-quality editorial density.

P13.rationale: The abstract geometric photo provides some atmospheric texture in the mid-section, but the majority of the page is a flat white background with no intentional texture or atmosphere.

P14.rationale: The geometric photo is used as a decorative band without overlaid text, so scrim treatment is not critically needed, but no treatment is applied to the image itself.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The abstract geometric/architectural stock image is generic and not specific to any real business context, reducing credibility.

N08.rationale: There is a notably large empty white band between the photo and the numbered grid, and the bottom section with the 'good news' callout leaves considerable dead whitespace below it.

N10.rationale: No text is placed directly over the photo; the image and text occupy separate, clearly delineated zones with no awkward overlap.
